facts.text: OHSU does not admit first-time freshmen directly from high school; applicants to its 3-year Bachelor of Science in Nursing must complete 28 prerequisite college quarter credits before entering.

sources.title: Nursing School Admissions FAQ: OHSU Requirements and More
sources.quote: 3-year B.S. program: You must complete 28 prerequisite credits by the end of fall term before you start your program.
